definitions.explanation: The act of exchanging one currency for another, or exchanging bills for coins.

examples.japanese: ドルを{円|えん}に{両替|りょうがえ}したい。
examples.english: I want to exchange dollars for yen.

examples.japanese: {両替|りょうがえ}{所|じょ}はどこですか。
{千円|せんえん}{札|さつ}を{小銭|こぜに}に{両替|りょうがえ}してもらえますか。
examples.english: Could you exchange this 1000-yen bill for coins?
examples.notes: Also used for breaking bills into smaller denominations

notes:
USAGE: {両替|りょうがえ} can refer to both (1) exchanging foreign currency and (2) breaking bills into coins or smaller bills.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{両替|りょうがえ}する (to exchange money)
・{両替|りょうがえ}{所|じょ} (currency exchange office)
・{両替|りょうがえ}{機|き} (change machine)
・{両替|りょうがえ}{レート} (exchange rate)

RELATED:
・{為替|かわせ} - exchange (financial term)
・{外貨|がいか} - foreign currency
・{換金|かんきん} - conversion to cash
